## Claim or formula

Link to the document and section. Include source ID (Lxx) / primary paper, PDF page or equation.

## Assumptions and information pattern

State model, control domain, uncertainty, quantifier order, and policy class.

## Evidence

Provide a derivation, counterexample, original-source comparison, or numerical check.
Identify whether this is a proven error or an open interpretation.

## Proposed correction

Describe the corrected statement and affected baselines/guarantees.
